rationale: The user asked for more to do with the lotus flowers, the lanterns and the fireflies. The slate gives each loved thing one "pure" feature and ties them together with two cross-object loops, plus one new thing that clearly belongs (Hush, the judges' top score). Lotus: Buds that turn to the hand (a bud leans toward a fingertip and opens for a patient still hand) and Lantern among the lily pads (a placed lantern warms a bud open — lantern x lotus). Lanterns: Touch and nudge (hands finally have contact with a floating lantern) plus the two cross loops. Fireflies: The ribbon (a slow open palm-up drift draws a strand of light) and Firefly escort (fireflies ride up with a released lantern, spill as sparks, and when the star is born a wave of flashes and restated lotus notes rolls across the lake — the "Lake passes it on" proposal merged in, since both live in fireflies.js on the same lantern chain and both touch the synchrony pass). Gesture map, all disjoint: still open hand with a fingertip 9–22 cm over a closed bud (buds) / slow-drifting open palm-up hand (ribbon; requires !still) / open non-pinching hand physically touching a lantern flank (nudge) / open still palm-down hand flat on the surface with the thumb dipped (hush; excluded from buds by !submerged) / the existing grab and release only (pads, escort). None gives a new meaning to pinch-and-move; none resembles the leave pose (palms facing each other, above water, 9 cm apart). Total +0 draw calls. Judge flags addressed in the specs: the buds-turn harness wrist is raised so the tip sits in the hover band, not the touch radius; the nudge spec eases the hand attraction out inside contact range; the escort coherence assertion is made deterministic (per-firefly scheduled flash times exposed by the module) and the cloud kick strengthened; Hush's calm plumbing goes through a wavesim-owned record so the raise is seen by the sim despite module order. Shared-file coordination for the integrator: lotus.js is extended by three features through one identical `openFlower(i, opts)` signature; fireflies.js gets two new states with fixed numbers (ESCORT = 4, FOLLOW = 5) that both features must exclude from the sync pass and clear in the repel/release paths; main.js gains event names and stats fields listed per feature; hints are appended to the end of HINTS so ordering never conflicts. Suggested scenario order: existing calibrated + lantern steps -> lantern-nudge -> lotus-leans (cluster 0, before the existing lotus-bloomed step, which then opens the next closed bud) -> lantern-warms-lotus (next closed bud) -> existing firefly-landed -> firefly-escort/spill/lake-wave -> firefly-ribbon/hand-off -> hush steps -> existing locomotion and leave steps.

features.name: Buds that turn to the hand
features.spec:
# Buds that turn to the hand

A closed lotus bud leans toward the nearest fingertip of a hand within 35 cm, its glow warming as the hand nears. Hold a fingertip still 9–22 cm above the bud (not touching) and after 0.6 s a thin rising whisper starts; at 2 s the bud opens by itself with a softer, longer note than a touch gives. Zero draw calls, ~90 lines, all in `src/world/lotus.js`.

## Gesture (lotus.js update, after the existing float/bud pass, before the touch test)
Add to each flower record: `leanX = 0, leanZ = 0, lean = 0, hoverT = 0, stirred = false, warmGlow = 0`. Constants in a module object `LEAN = { far: 0.35, near: 0.08, angle: 0.40, tauIn: 0.6, tauOut: 1.2, hoverMin: 0.09, hoverMax: 0.22, stirAt: 0.6, openAt: 2.0, decay: 2 }` (no config.js change).

For each flower with `f.state === 'closed'` (skip opening/open/closing): over hands `h` with `h.visible && h.active && !h.submerged && !h.pinch.active && !h.grabbed`, find the nearest of `h.tips[0..4]` to `f.bud` (squared distances; 6 flowers x 2 hands x 5 tips = 60 checks). Let `d` be that distance and `h*` that hand.
- If `d < LEAN.far`: `p = 1 - smoothstep(LEAN.near, LEAN.far, d)`; horizontal unit `u = normalize((tip - bud).xz)`; target lean vector `= u * LEAN.angle * p`; ease `f.leanX/f.leanZ` toward it with `k = 1 - exp(-dt / LEAN.tauIn)`. Else ease toward 0 with `k = 1 - exp(-dt / LEAN.tauOut)`. `f.lean = hypot(leanX, leanZ)`. `f.warmGlow = p` (0 when no hand).
- Patience: if `LEAN.hoverMin <= d <= LEAN.hoverMax && h*.still` then `f.hoverT += dt`, else `f.hoverT = max(0, f.hoverT - LEAN.decay * dt)`; when hoverT reaches 0 set `f.stirred = false`.
- At `f.hoverT >= LEAN.stirAt && !f.stirred`: `f.stirred = true`; emit `'lotusstir' { index, note, pos: f.bud.clone(), hand: h* }`.
- At `f.hoverT >= LEAN.openAt`: `openFlower(i, { cause: 'patient', hand: h* })`; reset hoverT/stirred.
Open/opening/closing flowers ease lean to 0 and keep hoverT = 0.

## openFlower signature (shared with Lantern among the lily pads — identical in both)
Change to `openFlower(i, opts = {})` with `const { cause = 'touch', hand = null, openSeconds = OPEN_SECONDS } = opts`; store `f.openSeconds = openSeconds`; the `'opening'` branch uses `f.openSeconds` instead of `OPEN_SECONDS`. Event becomes `'lotusbloom' { index, note, pos, color, cause, hand }`. `ctx.lotus.open(i, opts)` passes opts through. The touch loop calls `openFlower(f.index, { cause: 'touch', hand: h })` (pass the hand whose tip hit). Energy/disturb unchanged for every cause.

## Visual
The lean goes into the instance matrix, pivoting at the base (geometry origin): if `f.lean > 1e-4`, `_q.setFromAxisAngle(axis = (leanZ, 0, -leanX) / lean, lean).multiply(_qy)` else `_q.copy(_qy)`; `_m.compose(f.position, _q, _s)`. Recompute `f.bud = (0, BUD_HEIGHT * f.scale, 0).applyQuaternion(_q).add(f.position)` every frame BEFORE the touch test and the glow update, so the touch target and the halo follow the leaning pod. Order inside update: float -> lean -> bud -> touch -> chord -> instances. Closed-bud halo gain becomes `GLOW_GAIN_CLOSED + 0.14 * f.warmGlow` (only while bloom < 0.25). If a screenshot shows the pod clipping a neighbouring pad, drop LEAN.angle to 0.30.

## Sound (src/audio/sfx.js)
- `on('lotusstir', e)`: `noiseBurst(S, { pos: e.pos, dur: 1.4, gain: 0.035, type: 'bandpass', freq: 2 * mtof(pitchFor(S, e.note, 6)), q: 14, sweepTo: 3 * mtof(pitchFor(S, e.note, 6)), kind: 'white', refDistance: 1.0 })` — a thin rising whisper that simply finishes if the hand leaves.
- In `onLotus`: when `e.cause === 'patient'` use `attack: 0.06, dur: 4.2, gain: 0.40` for the FM bell (everything else unchanged).

## Hint
None. The lean and the warming glow are the invitation; the existing 'lotus' hint stays.

## Edge cases
Tracking loss: `visible` false drops the hand from the search; lean decays over 1.2 s; hoverT decays at 2/s. Submerged hand: ignored entirely (a hush palm on the water near a bud never opens it by patience; the existing 8 cm touch rule still can). Pinching/grabbing hand: ignored, so pull-the-world and carrying a lantern past a bud only make it lean if the hand is open — and it is excluded anyway by `!pinch.active`. Both hands: nearest tip wins per flower. Locomotion active: hands are pinching, excluded. A still open hand also attracts fireflies: both rewards for stillness happen together. Interplay with 'lotus-lantern': a lantern-warmed bud has state 'opening' -> skipped.

## Harness (main.js + scenario.mjs)
main.js: add `'lotusstir'` to the eventLog list; add `'cause'` to summarize()'s key list; world().lotus entries gain `state: f.state, lean: +(f.lean || 0).toFixed(3)`.
Scenario, BEFORE the existing 'lotus-bloomed' step (so cluster 0 is still closed): `B = nearest world().lotus with open === false`; `setHand('right', [B.x, B.y + 0.18, B.z + 0.175], 0, { pitchDeg: 0, rollDeg: 0, curl: 0.15 })` — with the fake skeleton the index/middle tips sit ~0.15 m above the pod and 1–3 cm off axis: inside the 0.09–0.22 hover band, outside the 0.08 touch radius. `frames(20)`; `step('lotus-leans', world().lotus[B.index].lean >= 0.15)`. `frames(100)` (hand still: `still` after 0.5 s, stir at ~1.1 s, open at ~2.5 s); `step('lotus-patient-open', events() has 'lotusstir' {index: B.index} followed by 'lotusbloom' {index: B.index, cause: 'patient'} && world().lotus[B.index].open === true)`. Negative: `C = next closed bud`; `setHand('right', [C.x, C.y + 0.33, C.z + 0.175], 0, same extras)`; `frames(110)`; assert no 'lotusbloom' with index C.index. Then park the hand at `[0.25, 1.25, -0.4]` with `curl: 0.6` and continue with the existing lotus-bloomed step (it now picks the next closed bud).

## DESIGN.md
Add an interaction-table row: "Fingertip near a closed bud | nearest fingertip within 35 cm; still 9–22 cm above the pod for 2 s | the bud leans toward the finger and its glow warms; a whisper at 0.6 s, then it opens with a softer, longer note (`lotusbloom` cause 'patient')". Note the `openFlower(i, opts)` / `cause` field in the ctx notes.
features.exposes: flowers[i] gain { lean, leanX, leanZ, hoverT, openSeconds }; ctx.lotus.open(i, opts); world().lotus entries gain { state, lean }

features.name: Lantern among the lily pads
features.spec:
# Lantern among the lily pads

Carry a lantern to a closed lotus cluster and let it go in the water: the pads hold it, its amber light falls on the petals, and after ~2.5 s the bud opens slowly (5 s) as if warmed, staying open for as long as the lantern stays. No new gesture; zero draw calls; ~130 lines across lotus.js, lanterns.js and the lotus shader.

## openFlower signature (identical to 'lotus-lean' — implement the same change)
`openFlower(i, opts = {})`, `const { cause = 'touch', hand = null, openSeconds = OPEN_SECONDS } = opts`; `f.openSeconds` stored and used by the 'opening' branch; `'lotusbloom' { index, note, pos, color, cause, hand }`; `ctx.lotus.open(i, opts)` passes opts through; the touch loop passes `{ cause: 'touch', hand: h }`.

## Lanterns side (src/world/lanterns.js)
- Record fields: `touched = false` (set true in `onGrab`; reset false in `respawnFar`), `amongPads = false`.
- Floating branch, right after `vx/vz` are built from wind + walk + incoming/homing and BEFORE the hand-attraction term: `L.amongPads = false`; if `ctx.lotus?.clusters` exists, find the nearest cluster horizontally (6 hypot); if `< PADS.hold (0.40)` then `vx *= 0.25; vz *= 0.25; L.amongPads = true`. The attraction, head-avoidance and separation terms are added after, unchanged, so an open hand can still coax it out. Constants: `const PADS = { hold: 0.40 }`.

## Lotus side (src/world/lotus.js)
Constants `WARM = { enter: 0.45, exit: 0.55, minBright: 0.3, need: 2.5, cap: 3.5, openSeconds: 5.0, linger: 10, energy: 0.08, glowLight: 0.6 }`. Flower fields: `warm = 0, warmNear = false, lanternIdx = -1`.
Each frame (after the bud pass, before the touch test): for each flower, scan `ctx.lanterns.list` (<= 24 hypot): candidates are `L.state === 'floating' && L.touched && !L.incoming && !L.dropping && L.bright > WARM.minBright`; `d = hypot(L.position.x - f.position.x, L.position.z - f.position.z)`. Hysteresis: `f.warmNear` becomes true when the nearest candidate `d < WARM.enter`, false when `> WARM.exit`. `f.warm = clamp(f.warm + (warmNear ? dt : -2 * dt), 0, WARM.cap)`. If `f.warm > WARM.need && f.state === 'closed' && f.bloom < 0.25`: `openFlower(i, { cause: 'lantern', openSeconds: WARM.openSeconds })` — inside openFlower the energy bump for cause 'lantern' is `WARM.energy` (0.08) instead of `CONFIG.energy.lotus`, and the disturb is `(0.18, 0.18)`. While `warmNear && f.state === 'open'`: `f.timer = min(f.timer, f.stay - WARM.linger)` so it closes only 10 s after the lantern leaves.
Also record, for the shader, the brightest lantern (any state except rising, bright > 0.05) within `WARM.glowLight` of each flower: `aLantern[i] = (L.position.x, y, z, L.bright * smoothstep(0.6, 0.35, d))`, else w = 0.

## Visual (src/shaders/lotus.js)
flowerGeo gains `aLantern` (InstancedBufferAttribute vec4, 6 instances, DynamicDrawUsage, written each frame). LOTUS_FLOWER_VERT: declare `attribute vec4 aLantern; varying float vWarm;` and after `vNormalW` is set: `vec3 toL = aLantern.xyz - wp.xyz; float d2 = dot(toL, toL); vWarm = aLantern.w * max(dot(vNormalW, normalize(toL + vec3(1e-4))), 0.0) / (1.0 + 12.0 * d2);`. LOTUS_FLOWER_FRAG: declare `varying float vWarm;` and add `col += vWarm * vec3(1.0, 0.70, 0.34) * 0.9;` to the petal and pod branches before the fog mix (not the base). Petals read amber on the lantern side, moon-pale on the other. Halo gain: `+ 0.10 * smoothstep(0, 1, f.warm)` added to the per-instance glowGain (mirror follows). The 5 s open uses the existing easeOutCubic with `f.openSeconds`.

## Sound (src/audio/sfx.js onLotus)
When `e.cause === 'lantern'`: `triggerBell(S, { midi, pos, gain: 0.32, dur: 5.0, kind: 'ceramic', attack: 0.35, wet: 0.4, tag: 'lotus' })` so the note swells instead of striking; tuned bowl layer at gain 0.18. The lantern's crackle and the existing 'lanternsplash' at set-down need no change.

## Hint (src/world/hints.js)
Append to HINTS: `{ id: 'lanternlotus', text: 'leave a lantern among the lily pads', after: 130, done: (ctx, s) => s.lanternBloomed, ready: (ctx, s) => s.grabbed && s.bloomed && nearestLotus(ctx) < REACH + 0.15 && nearestLantern(ctx) < REACH + 0.15 }`; `s.lanternBloomed` set in init from `'lotusbloom'` with `e.cause === 'lantern'`.

## Edge cases
Pinch semantics untouched (grab + in-water release are existing). `L.touched` keeps homing lanterns (which stop right beside cluster 0) from opening buds by themselves. A dropped-on-tracking-loss lantern (`dropping`) does not count until it has landed. Bobbing: 0.45/0.55 hysteresis + 2.5 s dwell. Leave pose / fireflies / hush unaffected. A lantern parked at every cluster holds the chord open indefinitely — accepted (the 'lotuschord' swell still fires once per episode). Wind is damped to 1 cm/s among pads, so a placed lantern eventually leaves and the flower closes 10 s later.

## Harness
main.js: add `'cause'` to summarize()'s keys; world().lanterns entries gain `pads: !!l.amongPads, touched: !!l.touched`; world().lotus entries gain `state`. Scenario, AFTER the existing 'lotus-bloomed' step: `B = nearest world().lotus with open === false`; `L2 = nearest floating world().lanterns entry`; `head = world().head`; `u = normalize((B.x - head[0], B.z - head[2]))`. Grab: `setHand('right', [L2.x, L2.y + 0.12, L2.z], 0, { pitchDeg: 0, rollDeg: 0, curl: 0.1 }); frames(12); setHand(same, 1); frames(12)`; assert a 'grab'. Carry: 48 frames lerping the wrist (pinch 1) to `T = [B.x + 0.33 * u.x, level + 0.10, B.z + 0.33 * u.z + 0.135]` where `level = stats().water` — the pinch point lands ~0.30 m beyond the bud on the far side from the head (tips never within 0.08 of the bud), and the lantern's bottom hangs ~0.26 m below the pinch point, under water. `setHand('right', T, 0, same extras); frames(6)`; assert 'lanternsplash'. Park: `setHand('right', [0.25, 1.25, -0.4], 0, { curl: 0.6 })`. `frames(144)` (4 s). `step('lantern-warms-lotus', events().some(e => e.type === 'lotusbloom' && e.detail.cause === 'lantern' && e.detail.index === B.index) && world().lotus[B.index].open && world().lotus[B.index].bloom < 1 && world().lanterns[L2.index].pads === true && page.evaluate(i => window.__nocturneCtx.lotus.flowers[i].warm > 2.5, B.index))`. Optional: `clock.step = 0.1; frames(800)`; assert the flower is still open; restore step.

## DESIGN.md / README
Interaction row: "Lantern set down among lily pads | a lantern you have handled floats within 45 cm of a cluster for 2.5 s | the pads hold it, its light warms the petals amber, the bud opens over 5 s (`lotusbloom` cause 'lantern') and stays open until 10 s after the lantern drifts away". README 'What to do' line: add '· leave a lantern among the lily pads'.
events: lotusbloom { index, note, pos, color, cause: 'lantern', hand: null }
features.exposes: flowers[i] gain { warm, warmNear, openSeconds }; lantern records gain { touched, amongPads }; world().lanterns entries gain { pads, touched }

features.name: Touch and nudge
features.spec:
# Touch and nudge

Today a hand passes straight through a floating lantern. Now an open hand meets it: a slow hand rests it against the fingers where it nuzzles; a brisk sideways brush sends it gliding off with a slow spin, its flame leaning and guttering, and a ring spreading from the hull. Nothing to learn; zero draw calls; ~130 lines in `src/world/lanterns.js` plus one sound.

## Gesture (lanterns.js update, inside the floating branch, after the attraction term and before the head-avoidance term)
Constants `NUDGE = { reach: 0.45, skin: 0.008, body: 0.075, pushMax: 0.7, pushK: 0.9, spinK: 2.5, spinMax: 2.5, pushDecay: 1.5, spinDecay: 0.9, gutterSpeed: 0.35, eventGap: 0.25, attEaseNear: 0.095, attEaseFar: 0.175 }`. Contact joints: `['wrist', 'middle-finger-metacarpal', 'index-finger-phalanx-proximal', 'middle-finger-phalanx-proximal', 'ring-finger-phalanx-proximal', 'pinky-finger-phalanx-proximal', ...TIP_NAMES]` (import TIP_NAMES from core/hands.js). New record fields allocated at spawn: `push: new THREE.Vector2(), spinKick: 0, touchT: -1e9, inContact: false`.

Per hand `h` with `h.visible && h.active && !h.pinch.active && !h.grasp && !h.grabbed` (a grasp within reach already grabs via hands.js; a pinching hand is grabbing or pulling the world), skip unless `h.palm.position.distanceToSquared(L.position) < NUDGE.reach^2`. Only for `L.state === 'floating' && !L.dropping`. For each contact joint `j` with `j.valid`: `jr = j.radius + NUDGE.skin`; vertical band `L.position.y - 0.11 < j.position.y < L.top.y - 0.02` (the paper flank only; a joint above the rim never pushes); `dx = L.position.x - j.position.x, dz = L.position.z - j.position.z, d = hypot(dx, dz)`; contact if `d < NUDGE.body + jr` and `d > 1e-4`. Resolution: `pen = NUDGE.body + jr - d; n = (dx, dz) / d; P.x += n.x * pen; P.z += n.z * pen` (positional, no vertical push). Velocity transfer from the WORLD palm velocity `v = h.palm.velocity`: `vn = max(0, v.x * n.x + v.z * n.z)`; if `vn * NUDGE.pushK > push.dot(n)` then `push += n * (vn * NUDGE.pushK - push.dot(n))`; clamp `|push| <= NUDGE.pushMax`. Tangential: `vt = (v.x - n.x * vn, v.z - n.z * vn)`; `L.spinKick = clamp(L.spinKick + (n.x * vt.y - n.z * vt.x) * NUDGE.spinK * dt * 30, -NUDGE.spinMax, NUDGE.spinMax)`. Contact start (no contact last frame for this lantern, and `t - L.touchT > NUDGE.eventGap`): `L.touchT = t`; gutter if `vn > NUDGE.gutterSpeed`: `L.bright = max(0.3, L.bright - 0.2)` (the existing easing restores it); `ctx.water.disturb(P.x, P.z, 0.1, 0.05 + 0.2 * min(1, vn))`; `ctx.lanterns.touches++`; emit `'lanterntouch' { pos: P.clone(), hand: h, lantern: L, speed: vn }`. Set `L.inContact` for next frame.
Every frame (floating): `push *= max(0, 1 - NUDGE.pushDecay * dt); spinKick *= max(0, 1 - NUDGE.spinDecay * dt); vx += push.x; vz += push.y; L.leanT += push * 0.5` (heels away, added to the existing leanT), and the flame target becomes `max(existing target, 1 + min(0.7, |push| * 1.2))` while `|push| > 0.05`. Yaw: `L.yaw += (L.spin + L.spinKick) * dt` in the floating case. Attraction ease-out (so the nuzzle does not jitter against the pull): multiply the existing `ATTRACT_K` contribution by `smoothstep(ad, NUDGE.attEaseNear, NUDGE.attEaseFar)` where `ad` is the horizontal distance from `h.pinch.point` to `P`. Held and rising lanterns are never pushed.

## Visual
No new geometry: push/spin/lean go through the instance matrix, the flare through `pFlame`, the gutter through `aBright`; the water lights and the strength-scaled hull ripple follow automatically. No per-frame allocation (scalars + the record's Vector2).

## Sound (sfx.js)
`on('lanterntouch', e)`: `sp = clamp(e.speed / 0.8, 0, 1)`; `noiseBurst(S, { pos: e.pos, dur: 0.05 + 0.05 * sp, gain: 0.03 + 0.10 * sp, type: 'bandpass', freq: 900, q: 1.2 })` — a soft paper tap, louder for a brisk brush, nothing for a sustained nuzzle (rate-limited by the 0.25 s contact-start rule). The crackle slot rises with `L.flame` by itself.

## Hint
None. Do not count a touch as `s.grabbed`.

## Edge cases
Tracking loss: `visible` false ends contact; push decays. Submerged hand: the flank band starts 1 cm below the surface, so paddling joints are outside it; a hand half in the water can still nudge — intended. Both hands: each hand's joints tested independently. Locomotion active: pinching -> excluded. Fast swipe tunnelling (4 m/s cap = 5.5 cm/frame vs a 15 cm body): accepted. Pushed lantern drifting out of reach: existing homing returns it. Interplay with 'lantern-lotus': damping is applied before push is added, so a lantern among pads can still be nudged out. Leave pose: inside the 0.42 m head-avoidance radius, no lantern is there.

## Harness
main.js: add `'lanterntouch'` to the eventLog list; world().lanterns entries gain `push: +(l.push ? l.push.length() : 0).toFixed(3)`; stats() gains `lanternTouches: ctx.lanterns?.touches`. Scenario, right after the existing 'lantern-star' step (clock back at 1/36): `L = nearest floating lantern from world()`, `rig0 = world().rig`. Pose the right hand open with fingers along -X: `setHand('right', [L.x + 0.32, L.y + 0.02, L.z], 0, { yawDeg: 90, pitchDeg: 0, rollDeg: 0, curl: 0.05 })`; `frames(8)`; `L0 = world().lanterns[L.index]`. Sweep the wrist x from `L.x + 0.32` to `L.x + 0.05` over 20 frames (~0.49 m/s; the fingertips, 0.175 m ahead, pass through the body), sampling `world()` every 2 frames and keeping `minX`; `frames(10)`, sampling too. `step('lantern-nudged', events().some(e => e.type === 'lanterntouch' && e.detail.speed > 0.2 && e.detail.hand === 'right') && minX < L0.x - 0.10 && stats().hands.pinchR === false && no 'grab'/'pinchmiss' since the step began && hypot(rig - rig0) < 0.005)`. Then move the hand to `[0.25, 1.25, -0.4]` with `curl: 0.6`; `frames(30)`; assert `stats().lanternTouches >= 1` and the lantern is still 'floating'.

## DESIGN.md
Interaction row: "Touch a floating lantern | open, non-pinching hand; any finger/knuckle joint meets the paper flank | it gives: a slow hand rests it against the fingers, a brisk brush (> 0.35 m/s) sends it gliding with a slow spin, the flame flares and gutters, a ring spreads from the hull, a paper tap (`lanterntouch`)".
features.exposes: ctx.lanterns.touches (count); lantern records gain { push: Vector2, spinKick, touchT, inContact }; world().lanterns entries gain { push }; stats().lanternTouches

features.name: Firefly escort, and the lake passes it on
features.spec:
# Firefly escort, and the lake passes it on

Let a lantern go and up to ten nearby fireflies (including any resting on the releasing hand) lift off with it, spiralling round the flame as it rises, the flame flaring with them. A few metres up they spill away as sparks and their home cloud flashes in step for a while. When that lantern finally becomes a star, the news rolls back across the water: a wave of firefly flashes spreads from where you stand at walking pace, every open lotus it passes brightens and restates its note, and the crickets pause for a breath. No new gesture; zero draw calls.

## Firefly state numbers (shared with 'firefly-ribbon')
`ESCORT = 4` (this feature), `FOLLOW = 5` (ribbon). Both must be excluded from the synchrony pass (`state !== WANDER && state !== SCATTER` already does), from LANDED/APPROACH handling, and cleared by the repel loop and every `releaseSlot` path (`escortL[i] = -1`).

## Escort (src/world/fireflies.js)
Constants `ESC = { max: 10, wanderRange: 3.0, handRange: 0.6, spillAt: 4.2, orbitA: 2.6, orbitR: 0.14, orbitRJit: 0.12, speedMax: 1.0, kick: 6, kickGain: 2.0 }`. Arrays: `escortL = new Int8Array(N).fill(-1)`, scratch `escIdx = Int16Array(10)`, `escD = Float32Array(10)`; `S.syncKick = new Float32Array(3)`, `S.kickedCloud = -1`, `escortCount`.
On `'lanternrelease' { lantern: L }` (subscribe in init): nearest-first insertion into the fixed 10-slot arrays of (a) WANDER fireflies with `cooldown <= 0` within `ESC.wanderRange` of `L.position`, (b) LANDED/APPROACH fireflies within `ESC.handRange` of it (the releasing hand). For each recruit: `releaseSlot(i); state[i] = ESCORT; escortL[i] = L.i; cooldown[i] = 0`. If count > 0 emit `'fireflyescort' { pos: L.position.clone(), count, lantern: L }`.
Per-frame ESCORT branch (in the main loop): `L = ctx.lanterns.list[escortL[i]]`; if `!L || L.state !== 'rising' || L.riseTime > ESC.spillAt` -> spill (below). Else `a = t * ESC.orbitA + seed[i] * 6.283; r = ESC.orbitR + ESC.orbitRJit * seed[i]; target = (L.position.x + cos(a) * r, L.position.y + 0.05 + (seed[i] - 0.5) * 0.25, L.position.z + sin(a) * r)`; desired speed `min(ESC.speedMax, 0.15 + d * 3)`; velocity lerp `k = min(1, dt * 5)`; `bright[i] = max(blink(i), 0.55)`; this state bypasses the yMax band clamp. Count escorts per lantern into a scratch `Int8Array(24)` zeroed each frame and write `L.escorts = n` on every rising lantern record (cross-module field; document in both file headers).
Spill (one-shot per lantern via a `spilled` flag on the lantern record, reset in `respawnFar` and `onGrab`): for each escort of that lantern: `vel = outward * 0.9 + (rnd - 0.5) * 0.3, vy = -0.25 + rnd * 0.3; state = SCATTER; timer = t + 1.0 + rnd * 0.6; cooldown = 4; bright = 1; escortL = -1`; `S.syncKick[k] = ESC.kick` for the cloud most escorts came from (`homeIdx`), `S.kickedCloud = k`; emit `'fireflyspill' { pos, count, lantern }`. In the sync pass: `syncKick[k] -= SYNC.dt` and while `> 0`, `kg[k] = max(kg[k], ESC.kickGain * SYNC.kMax * R * SYNC.dt)` — with K about 4.8 rad/s against a 2–4.5 rad/s spread the cloud locks to R ~0.8 within a few seconds.
lanterns.js rising branch: `L.flame` target becomes `1 + 0.3 * min(1, (L.escorts || 0) / 4)` (instead of the plain 1).

## The lake passes it on
fireflies.js subscribes to `'lanternstar'`: `S.waveAt = t + 0.8; S.waveOX/OZ = headWorld.x/z` (the star's own sparkle strikes first). On the first update with `t >= S.waveAt` (`WAVE = { speed: 2.5, hold: 6, delay: 0.8 }`): one O(N) pass over non-steady WANDER/SCATTER fireflies: `d = hypot(x - ox, z - oz); tPeak = t + d / WAVE.speed; rise = FLASH.rise * (0.85 + 0.3 * seed[i]); phase[i] = ((rise - tPeak) % pd + pd) % pd` so each flash peaks exactly as the 2.5 m/s front reaches it; `S.waveHold = WAVE.hold` (in the sync pass while waveHold > 0: `kg[k] = 0` for all clouds, and it overrides syncKick); fill `ctx.fireflies.wave = { fired: true, t0: t, ox, oz, speed, count, sample: Int16Array(32), sampleT: Float32Array(32) }` with the first 32 rewritten fireflies of cloud 0 and their `tPeak`; emit `'lakewave' { pos: new Vector3(ox, level, oz), count }`. lotus.js subscribes to `'lakewave'`: for every flower with `f.open`, `f.waveAt = t + hypot(f.position.x - ox, f.position.z - oz) / 2.5` (else -1); in the instance loop `sf = f.waveAt > 0 ? sin(PI * clamp((t - f.waveAt) / 2.0, 0, 1)) : 0`, `surgeF = max(surge, 0.7 * sf)` replaces `surge` for that instance's glow size/gain; `uSurge` stays the global max. Hand-resting fireflies (LANDED/APPROACH/ESCORT/FOLLOW) are skipped by the pass.

## Sound
sfx.js: `'fireflyescort'` -> for `k < min(count, 5)`: `triggerBell(S, { midi: pitchFor(S, k, 6), pos, gain: 0.07, dur: 0.9, kind: 'glass', when: now + 0.05 + k * 0.09, wet: 0.5, tag: 'escort' })`. `'fireflyspill'` -> four descending `pitchFor(S, 4 - k, 6)` glass bells 70 ms apart gain 0.05 + `noiseBurst({ type: 'highpass', freq: 4000, q: 0.7, dur: 0.3, gain: 0.03 })`. `'lakewave'` -> for each `f` in `ctx.lotus.flowers` with `f.open`: `triggerBell(S, { midi: pitchFor(S, f.note, 5), pos: f.bud, gain: 0.10, dur: 2.6, kind: 'glass', attack: 0.03, wet: 0.7, when: now + hypot(f.bud - head).xz / 2.5, tag: 'wave' })` plus one breath `noiseBurst({ kind: 'pink', type: 'lowpass', freq: 600, q: 0.5, dur: 1.5, gain: 0.05, pos: head })`. ambience.js: `S.offs.push(ctx.events.on('lakewave', () => startle(2, 4)))`. music.js: nothing (the existing release swell and aurora voice already underlie it).

## Hint (hints.js, appended)
`{ id: 'escort', text: 'let a lantern go with fireflies on your hand', after: 200, done: (ctx, s) => s.escorted, ready: (ctx, s) => s.fireflyLanded && s.released && nearestLantern(ctx) < REACH + 0.15 }`; `s.released` from 'lanternrelease', `s.escorted` from 'fireflyescort' with count >= 3.

## Edge cases
Re-grab within 3 s: `L.state` becomes 'held' -> escorts spill at once. Timejump: ESCORT keys on `L.riseTime` (nothing to clamp); waveAt/waveHold are clamped to `nt + 1`. Escort recruiting skips FOLLOW fireflies and vice versa. Fast hand scatters escorts like anything else. Wave hold wins over a concurrent kick.

## Harness
main.js: add `'fireflyescort', 'fireflyspill', 'lakewave'` to the eventLog list; stats() gains `fireflyEscorting: ctx.fireflies?.escortCount`. Scenario, right after the existing 'firefly-landed' step (right hand palm-up at `[0.3, 1.3, -0.45]`): `L2 = nearest floating lantern`; move the wrist over 144 frames (<= 0.3 m/s so landed fireflies stay) keeping `{ pitchDeg: 0, rollDeg: 180, curl: 0.02 }` to `[L2.x, L2.y + 0.15, L2.z + 0.10]`; ramp `pinch` 0 -> 1 over 24 frames; assert a 'grab'. Lift 0.40 m over 54 frames (pinch 1), then pinch 0 at the top; `frames(4)`; `step('firefly-escort', events().some(e => e.type === 'fireflyescort' && e.detail.count >= 1) && stats().fireflyEscorting >= 1)` (fallback holds even if the landed ones left: cloud 0's fringe is inside 3 m). Park the hand (`curl: 0.6`); `frames(180)`; `step('firefly-spill', 'fireflyspill' present && stats().fireflyEscorting === 0)`; `clock.step = 0.1`; poll up to 80 frames for `max(ctx.fireflies.coherence[ctx.fireflies.kickedCloud]) > 0.5`; keep stepping (still 0.1) polling `events()` until a new 'lanternstar' appears (<= 320 frames); set `clock.step = 1/36`; run frames until `ctx.fireflies.wave.fired` (<= 40); copy `sample/sampleT`; then for 150 frames record, per sampled index k, `max(brightness[sample[k]])` over frames with `|ctx.time.t - sampleT[k]| <= 0.12`; `step('lake-wave', 'lakewave' logged with count >= 100 && >= 75% of the 32 samples peaked > 0.6 && ctx.lotus.flowers.some(f => f.open) ? ctx.lotus.flowers.some(f => f.waveAt > 0) : true)`.

## DESIGN.md
Rows: "Release a lantern near fireflies | existing release | up to ten fireflies spiral up with it (`fireflyescort`), the flame flares, they spill as sparks ~4 s up (`fireflyspill`) and their cloud flashes together"; "A star is born | 0.8 s after `lanternstar` | a wave of flashes crosses the lake at 2.5 m/s from the player (`lakewave`), open lotus restate their notes in order, crickets pause". Document `L.escorts` in both module headers.
features.exposes: ctx.fireflies gains { escortCount, kickedCloud, wave: { fired, t0, ox, oz, speed, count, sample: Int16Array(32), sampleT: Float32Array(32) } }; lantern records gain { escorts, spilled }; flowers gain { waveAt }; stats().fireflyEscorting

features.name: The ribbon
features.spec:
# The ribbon

Carry an open hand slowly through the dark, palm up, and fireflies peel off the nearest cloud and string out behind it — a soft strand of light following every slow curve of the hand. Stop, and the strand gathers and lands on your fingers; move fast and it scatters. It sits exactly between the two rules players already know (still -> they land, fast -> they scatter). Zero draw calls; ~200 lines in `src/world/fireflies.js`.

## State number (shared with 'firefly-escort')
`FOLLOW = 5` (`ESCORT = 4` belongs to the escort). FOLLOW is excluded from the sync pass, LANDED/APPROACH handling, and cleared (`followHand[i] = -1; followIdx[i] = -1`) in the repel loop and every `releaseSlot` path; escort recruiting must skip FOLLOW fireflies.

## Gesture (per hand, in the hand-flag block)
Constants `RIB = { speedMin: 0.05, speedMax: 0.35, breakSpeed: 0.5, normalY: 0.15, pauseGrace: 0.4, lostGrace: 0.4, recruitAfter: 0.5, recruitEvery: 0.3, max: 16 (x particleScale, rounded), sampleStep: 0.02, ring: 256, spacing: 4, lift: 0.09, inbound: 0.3 }`. Per hand: `slowFor[2]`, `pauseT[2]`, `lostT[2]`, `drifting[2]`, `followers[2]`, `followArrived[2]`, ring `trail[2] = Float32Array(3 * 256)`, `trailHead[2]`, `trailN[2]`, `trailLast[2] = Vector3` (preallocated).
Drifting when: `h.visible && h.active && !h.submerged && !h.pinch.active && !h.grabbed && h.open && h.palm.normal.y > RIB.normalY && !h.still && h.palm.speed in [RIB.speedMin, RIB.speedMax] && h.palm.speedH >= 0.6 * h.palm.speed`. If drifting: `slowFor += dt; pauseT = 0`. Else if the only failure is `palm.speed < speedMin` or `h.still` (a pause) and `pauseT < RIB.pauseGrace`: `pauseT += dt` (keep slowFor). Else if `!h.visible` and `lostT < RIB.lostGrace`: `lostT += dt`. Else `slowFor = 0` and release all followers of that hand (WANDER, `cooldown = 4`), clear the trail. Any `palm.speed > RIB.breakSpeed`, pinch, submersion, or a closed hand releases immediately. Recruit while `slowFor > RIB.recruitAfter`, every `RIB.recruitEvery` s (own timer `followT[hi]`), the nearest WANDER firefly with `cooldown <= 0` within 14 m of the palm, up to `RIB.max` per hand: `state = FOLLOW; followHand = hi; followIdx = k (0..max-1, first free)`. Keep a `Int16Array(2 * max)` of follower slots so `followIdx` is unique per hand.
Trail: `T = palm.position + palm.normal * RIB.lift`; push a sample when `T.distanceTo(trailLast) >= RIB.sampleStep` (distance-based, so the strand keeps 8 cm spacing at any speed; ring holds 5 m). Follower `k` targets sample `head - RIB.spacing * (k + 1)` (clamped to the oldest sample when the trail is shorter) plus a seeded +/-0.03 m offset. Inbound followers (> `RIB.inbound` from their target) head for the live `T` at <= 0.6 m/s; steering is the APPROACH easing (`sp = min(0.6, 0.08 + 2.2 d)`, `k = min(1, dt * 3.5)`, the same wobble). Brightness: inbound `max(blink(i), 0.35)`; on the strand (d < 0.3) `0.7 + 0.2 * sin(t * 2.1 + seed * 31)` and count it as arrived. Followers stay while the hand remains open, visible, not submerged, not pinching and below `breakSpeed` — including when it stops.
Hand-off: the frame a hand with followers becomes `openStill`, for each free `SLOT_JOINTS` slot take the nearest follower: `state = APPROACH; slotHand = hi; slotIdx = s; slots[hi][s] = i; followHand = -1` (instant landings via the existing path); the rest hover on their samples. The existing repel (`speed > 0.7` within 0.6 m) scatters them like anything else. Accumulate `followCentroid` (Float32Array(6)) per hand from arrived followers in the main loop, no allocation.

## Sound (sfx.js)
`on('fireflyfollow', e)`: first arrival (count 1) -> `triggerBell(S, { midi: pitchFor(S, 2, 6), pos: e.pos, gain: 0.10, dur: 1.2, kind: 'glass', wet: 0.5 })`; eighth -> `pitchFor(S, 4, 6)` gain 0.12. Continuous 'hand voice' per hand (persistent, created in start: two sine oscillators -> lowpass 2500 Hz -> gain 0.0001 -> `api.spatial({ refDistance: 1.0, rolloff: 1.2, out: S.out.chimes })`): in the 30 Hz block, `pa.position` = that hand's `followCentroid`, `gain.setTargetAtTime(0.03 * smoothstep(0, 10, ctx.fireflies.followArrived[hi]), now, 0.3)`; in the 4 Hz block retune to `mtof(84 + mod12(currentChord.root))` and `mtof(84 + mod12(currentChord.fifth))` with `setTargetAtTime(..., 0.3)`. Kill in stop().

## Hint (hints.js, appended)
`{ id: 'ribbon', text: 'move an open hand slowly and they follow', after: 130, done: (ctx, s) => s.followed, ready: (ctx, s) => s.touchedWater }`; `s.followed` from the first 'fireflyfollow'.

## Edge cases
Tracking loss: 0.4 s grace, then release. Hand in water: released. Pinch (locomotion or grab): released — rig-local `palm.speed` also means gliding never counts as drifting. Both hands: independent, 16 each. Leave pose: needs still hands with normals horizontal; excluded by `normal.y > 0.15` and `!still`. Buds-turn needs a still hand; a drifting hand only makes buds lean. Landed fireflies on a drifting hand: unaffected (they leave above 0.35 m/s as today). Timejump: nothing to clamp (no absolute timers).

## Harness
main.js: add `'fireflyfollow'` to the eventLog list; stats() gains `fireflyFollowers: [ctx.fireflies.followers[0], [1]]`, `fireflyFollowArrived: [...]`. Scenario, after the escort steps (hands free): park the left hand `setHand('left', [-0.3, 1.25, -0.45], 0, { pitchDeg: 0, rollDeg: 0, curl: 0.6 })` (not open, attracts nothing). Right hand palm up, 4 legs of 96 frames moving the wrist between world x 0.10 and 0.50 (dx 0.00417/frame = 0.15 m/s), y 1.30, z -0.45, `{ pitchDeg: 0, rollDeg: 180, curl: 0.02 }` (stillDisp over 0.5 s = 0.075 > 0.03, so never `still`; speedH = speed). After the 384 frames plus `frames(36)`: `step('firefly-ribbon', stats().fireflyFollowers[1] >= 3 && stats().fireflyFollowArrived[1] >= 2 && events().some(e => e.type === 'fireflyfollow' && e.detail.hand === 'right') && no 'fireflyland' with hand 'right' since the sweep began)`. Then hold the hand still at its last pose for 120 frames: `step('ribbon-handoff', a 'fireflyland' with detail.hand === 'right' appears within those frames)` (a fresh recruit from 3.6 m needs ~7 s, so this proves the hand-off). Move the right hand to `[0.25, 1.25, -0.4]` with `curl: 0.6` afterwards.

## DESIGN.md / README
Row: "Slow open hand, palm up | open, above water, palm.normal.y > 0.15, not still, 0.05–0.35 m/s sideways | fireflies peel off the nearest cloud and string out 8 cm apart along the hand's path (`fireflyfollow`); stop and they land, move fast and they scatter". README 'What to do': add '· move an open hand slowly and watch what follows'.
features.exposes: ctx.fireflies gains { followers: Int16Array(2), followArrived: Int16Array(2), followCentroid: Float32Array(6) }; stats().fireflyFollowers, stats().fireflyFollowArrived

features.name: Hush
features.spec:
# Hush

Rest an open palm flat on the water and keep it there: after a moment a circle of perfect stillness spreads from under the hand, ripples die at its edge and the stars come up through the glass-still disc. The plankton go quiet inside it, a low bowl note holds, raindrop notes begin to fall, and lifting the hand lets the lake breathe again. Zero draw calls (two uniforms), a new ~200-line module `src/world/hush.js` registered in `src/world/index.js` after `fireflies` (before `leave`).

## Plumbing (order-safe)
`player.js` writes `ctx.water.calm` before any module runs and wavesim/water run first, so hush must not depend on module order. wavesim.init creates `ctx.water.hush = { data: new Float32Array(8), strength: 0 }` (two vec4: uv centre x, y; radius in uv units; strength) and a uniform `uHush: { value: ctx.water.hush.data }`; wavesim.update uses `calm = max(ctx.water.calm || 0, 0.6 * ctx.water.hush.strength)` for `uDamping`. water.init adds `uHush: { value: new Float32Array(8) }` (world metres: x, z, radius, strength) and water.update copies `ctx.water.hushWorld` (a Float32Array(8) the hush module fills; wavesim allocates it too as `ctx.water.hushWorld`) and uses the same max for `uCalm`. The hush module writes both arrays each frame (one-frame lag, no allocation). Guard: if `ctx.water.hush` is missing, hush.init throws (module skipped).

## Gesture (hush.js)
Constants `HUSH = { normalY: -0.8, yMin: -0.05, yMax: 0.03, hold: 0.6, holdDecay: 3, tauIn: 0.8, tauOut: 1.2, r0: 0.25, r1: 1.2, grow: 3.0, follow: 1.0, onAt: 0.05, offAt: 0.02, calmGain: 0.6 }`. Per hand a circle `{ x, z, r, s, hold, active, wasActive }`. Pose = `h.visible && h.active && h.open && h.palm.normal.y < HUSH.normalY && h.palm.position.y - level in [yMin, yMax] && h.still && !h.pinch.active && !h.grabbed` (`h.still` is computed regardless of submersion; the palm pads dip, which is expected). `hold += dt` while pose else `hold = max(0, hold - holdDecay * dt)`. When `hold >= HUSH.hold` and not active: activate with centre = palm xz, `r = r0`, `s = 0`, `growT = 0`. While active and pose: `s += (1 - s) * (1 - exp(-dt / tauIn))`; centre lerps toward the palm at `HUSH.follow` per second; `growT += dt; r = r0 + (r1 - r0) * easeOutCubic(min(1, growT / grow))`. When the pose breaks: `s += (0 - s) * (1 - exp(-dt / tauOut)); r = r0 + (r1 - r0) * s`... keep `r` from shrinking faster than `s` (use `r = max(r0, rGrown * s)`). Events: `'hush' { hand, pos: palm.clone() }` when `s` crosses `onAt` upward; `'hushend' { hand }` when it falls below `offAt` after being active (then active = false). Each frame write `ctx.water.hushWorld[hi*4..] = (x, z, r, s)` and `ctx.water.hush.data[hi*4..] = (frac(x / tile), frac(z / tile), r / tile, s)`; `ctx.water.hush.strength = max(s0, s1)`. Expose `ctx.hush = { strength, circles: [{ x, z, r, s, active }, ...], count }` (count = activations).

## Visual
wavesim fragment, after `vel` and before `hn`: `float hf = 0.0; for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { vec2 dv = vUv - uHush[i].xy; dv -= floor(dv + 0.5); float r = max(uHush[i].z, 1e-4); hf = max(hf, uHush[i].w * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.6 * r, r, length(dv)))); } vel *= 1.0 - 0.7 * hf;` and after the disturbance loop `hn *= 1.0 - 0.15 * hf;` (waves entering the circle die within a few steps; height relaxes flat). water fragment, after `dPlayer`: `float hf = 0.0; for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { vec2 hd = p - uHush[i].xy; float hr = max(uHush[i].z, 1e-3); float hl = length(hd); hf = max(hf, uHush[i].w * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.6 * hr, hr, hl))); }` then `nxy *= 1.0 - 0.92 * hf;` (mirror), after `F` is computed `F = max(F, 0.32 * hf);` (a deliberate gentle boost so the stars and aurora come up through the disc at the steep viewing angle), `bio *= 1.0 - 0.9 * hf;`, and the spreading edge: `col += uPlankton2 * 0.10 * uHush[i].w * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.035, abs(hl - hr))) * (1.0 - hr / 1.2)` accumulated in the loop. Both water meshes share the uniforms. Verify in a harness screenshot that the disc is not a grey plate; if it is, drop 0.32 to 0.22.

## Sound
sfx.js: `on('hush', e)`: `midi = 48 + mod12(currentChord.root)`; `triggerBell(S, { midi, pos: e.pos, gain: 0.22, dur: 6, kind: 'ceramic', attack: 0.12, wet: 0.5, tag: 'hush' })` + `layer = pickTuned(S, BOWLS, midi + 12)` at gain 0.16 via playAt. Calm drone gate in the 4 Hz block: `calm = max(ctx.water.calm, ctx.calm, ctx.hush?.strength || 0)`. music.js: on 'hush' `S.hushing = true`, on 'hushend' `S.hushing = (ctx.hush?.strength || 0) > 0.02`; raindrop gate becomes `calmWorld = (energy < 0.15 && !anySub) || S.hushing`, next-drop interval `3 + 4 * rng()` s while hushing (the hand is submerged, so the old gate alone would never let them fall). ambience.js: nothing (crickets keep going; the swish falls silent by itself).

## Hint (hints.js, appended)
`{ id: 'hush', text: 'rest a hand flat on the water and be still', after: 140, done: (ctx, s) => s.hushed, ready: (ctx, s) => s.touchedWater }`; `s.hushed` set when a 'hush' event has fired and `ctx.hush.strength >= 0.8` has been observed (check in the hints update).

## Edge cases
Tracking loss: pose false, s decays over 1.2 s. Pinch breaks the pose (pull-the-world untouched; a lantern within 13 cm of the pinch point is grabbed as before). Leave: needs neither hand submerged and palms facing each other — a hush hand is submerged with its normal down. Fireflies: submerged hand, no recruiting. Buds-turn excludes submerged hands; the existing touch rule may still open a bud under the palm (fine). Ribbon excluded (palm up, moving). Both hands: two circles. Locomotion active: pinching. A palm pressed deeper than 5 cm gets nothing (calibration puts the surface where the eyes expect).

## Harness
main.js: add `'hush', 'hushend'` to the eventLog list; stats() gains `hush: ctx.hush?.strength`. Scenario, after the ribbon steps, hands parked: `L = stats().water`. Control ripple: `page.evaluate(() => window.__nocturneCtx.water.disturb(0.19, -0.48, 0.15, 0.3)); frames(15); h0 = simSnapshot().maxH` (expect >= 0.04); `frames(120)`. `setHand('right', [0.2, L + 0.012, -0.45], 0, { pitchDeg: 0, rollDeg: 0, curl: 0.05 })` — palm joint at L + 0.014 with normal (0,-1,0), thumb tip at L - 0.018 (submerged), hand open and perfectly still; `frames(120)`; `step('hush-circle-forms', stats().hush > 0.8 && ctx.hush.circles[1].r > 0.8 && ctx.hands.right.still === true && a 'hush' event with detail.hand === 'right')`. Same disturb again; `frames(15)`; `h1 = simSnapshot().maxH`; `step('hush-stills-the-water', h1 < 0.4 * h0)`. `setHand('right', [0.2, L + 0.3, -0.45], 0, { curl: 0.6 }); frames(90)`; `step('hush-dissolves', stats().hush < 0.1 && a 'hushend' event)`. Also assert `stats().drawCalls` unchanged vs the pre-step value.

## DESIGN.md / README
Row: "Palm flat on the water | open, palm-down (normal.y < -0.8), within 5 cm of the surface, still for 0.6 s | a disc of glass-still water spreads to 1.2 m over 3 s: ripples die at its edge, the stars come up through it, plankton go dark inside, a bowl note holds and raindrop notes fall (`hush`/`hushend`); lifting the hand lets it dissolve". Add hush.js to the architecture listing. README 'What to do': '· rest a hand flat on the water and be still'.
features.exposes: ctx.hush = { strength, circles: [{ x, z, r, s, active }, { ... }], count }; ctx.water.hush = { data: Float32Array(8), strength }; ctx.water.hushWorld: Float32Array(8); stats().hush

rejected.name: The lake passes it on
rejected.why: Not rejected — merged into 'Firefly escort' as the star-wave half of one lantern-release chain (same file, same synchrony pass; the hold-vs-kick interaction is resolved in one spec).

rejected.name: Cupped light (#9, two-hand firefly bowl)
rejected.why: Highest wow but the costliest risks: a shared hands.js glow hook, two side-by-side hands that occlude each other on Quest, ~8 s recruit latency, and a new two-hand pose adjacent to the one two-hand gesture the app has (leave). The ribbon deepens fireflies with a one-hand gesture that tracks reliably; revisit the bowl once that has landed.

rejected.name: Cupped light (#22, water in the palm)
rejected.why: Gated on a 0.30–0.72 meanCurl band from a self-occluding cupped hand, which flickers on device; the flat disc risks reading as a sticker; thematically the same 'bowl of light' as #9.

rejected.name: Passing the flame
rejected.why: Changes a loved rule (some lanterns now refuse to rise and splash instead) and introduces a small puzzle; two pendulums held within 16 cm for 0.4 s is fiddly with real hands. Touch and nudge gives lanterns a body without altering what a lantern does.

rejected.name: Pick a bloom
rejected.why: Six states plus a float/bloom vertex split is more than one session; the breathe step needs the pinch within 22 cm of the visor where tracking degrades; and an 0.18 m grab radius on cluster 0 turns wade-pulls near the flowers into plucks, changing a learned location.

rejected.name: Pollen chain
rejected.why: Beautiful but the largest ecology build (both firefly vertex shaders plus the fragment, an N*4 attribute, two more states) and it lets the lake open buds without the player, which dilutes the touch; the chain harness depends on the seeded layout.

rejected.name: Petal brush
rejected.why: The brush trigger re-fires from fingertip jitter while a finger rests in a flower (a bell three times a second) and the harness sweep trips the flinch before any brush; needs a stroke-distance gate and a 192-grain pool (+1 draw call).

rejected.name: Pollen on the fingers
rejected.why: Cannot ship without Petal brush; complementary-colour lerps go grey without HSL work.

rejected.name: Carried light
rejected.why: Silently rewrites the landed-firefly leave rule, duplicates the lantern's lift-and-release meaning, and mints firefly stars into the same persisted star list, muddying the experience's one big payoff.

rejected.name: The far ones answer
rejected.why: A beat detector on jittery palm velocity with 5 cm strokes is the most fragile gesture proposed, and the payoff sits 3.6–7 m away where it is easily missed.

rejected.name: Shading the flame
rejected.why: The open-hand attraction pulls a lantern toward the pinch point, straight out of the 9 cm cover window, so the spec's own harness fails; the payoff is subtractive (a dimmed, then dead lantern under a still hand).

rejected.name: A wish on the paper
rejected.why: Tracing an 18 mm shell on a swinging pendulum with two hands 20 cm apart is exactly where Quest tracking is worst; the DataTexture/UV plumbing is a full session on its own.

rejected.name: Water writing
rejected.why: An azimuth keyboard and circle-to-open-buds read as an instrument and a magic circle rather than a living place; fingertips-only in a 6 cm band with a hovering palm is hard for real hands.

rejected.name: Stir
rejected.why: The sim already glows under a circling hand; the motes must justify a draw call and the lantern-carry assertion is marginal in the harness window.

rejected.name: Koi under the surface
rejected.why: Everything under the 0.88-alpha surface reaches the eye at ~12%; ~480 lines of new geometry and shader with the look unproven — a two-session feature.

rejected.name: Frogs on the lily pads
rejected.why: The 0.55 m/s startle inside 0.45 m fires on every ordinary reach into cluster 0 so frogs leap constantly; croaks pull the lake toward cartoon; a croak that does not sound like a buzzer is its own project.

rejected.name: Moon jelly for the calm
rejected.why: The most beautiful idea for this lake but ~540 lines, two shaders, both of the two allowed draw calls, and an additive dome whose visibility under the water is unknown.

rejected.name: Moths around the lanterns
rejected.why: Ambient decoration that never answers the hand (against the design pillars); pale non-additive sprites over additive glow risk reading as grey dust; +1 draw call.
